answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The karst counter is kept in dune and ledge shows each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2495 identities would post 4171 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
